Item name/rate/count preserved;effect interpretation/eligible processing/permissions/consumption are explicit project adoption. 47level QREF63790-007/QREF63789-007 publish10%charm without count;project adopts one each and the same additive-percentage-point interpretation. 89level QREF63788-010 publishes15%charm1;project applies same additive-percentage-point interpretation and existing permissions.

processing.scope: only real enhancement recipes explicitly in eligible owners;not synthesis/awakening/four-divine/gem/evolution/transfer/true conversion/legacy enhancement;cannot substitute gem_luck_charm or four_divine_luck_charm
processing.input: optional null or exactly one unit from explicit real own carried enhancement_luck_charm_5, enhancement_luck_charm_10 or enhancement_luck_charm_15 stack;exact stack_id and expected revision/quantity1 in command;one selector only,not multiple charm types or multiple units;no auto choice from warehouse or alternate item
processing.formula: selected:effective_bp=min(10000,base_success_probability_bp+selected_definition.enhancement_bonus_bp);without charm use base exactly. Resolve exact adopted item from authoritative selected stack:5%=>500bp,10%=>1000bp,15%=>1500bp,never trust command-supplied bonus or derive it from a name;additive percentage points,not base*1.05/1.10/1.15
processing.base_guaranteed: base10000 with charm rejects before any cost/RNG/revision;omit charm to perform original guaranteed recipe
processing.tiers_interpretation: existing tiers success_probability_bp/random_draw_required describe base no-charm recipe;selected charm uses effective_bp and effective draw rule here;no change to base costs/tiers or eligibility
processing.draw: effective_bp10000 no RNG advance/draw;otherwise one uniform original host draw0..9999,success iff draw<effective_bp;no independent charm roll
processing.consumption: on valid committed attempt consume exactly one charm plus original stones/silver on both success and failure;original instance success/failure/preservation unchanged;invalid/cancel/stale/insufficient input/cap consumes nothing
processing.preflight: require original source inventory and full instance legal before consumption; revalidate NPC/service/owner/recipe/charm ID/binding/source stack/revisions; final inventory after all inputs and original instance outcome must be legal,never use consumed charm to repair originally invalid overweight state
processing.quote: show base and effective probabilities,exact selected charm item/rate and charm/stone stacks and silver,success/failure states;quote never consumes/advancesRNG;include explicit loss of charm on failure
processing.identity: command digest/quote bind optional charm selector(null or stack_id+expected_revision+quantity1),resolved exact charm item_id plus definition/version and base/effective bp and original recipe/version;same command altered charm selection rejects,not new roll
processing.commit: one05/19host transaction for original costs/charm stack consumption/instance flow/silver flow/RNG/character+inventory revisions+receipt;original owner determines exact revisions once,not extra revision for modifier
processing.receipt: retain original base/effective bp,charm null or resolved item_id/definition bonus and selected stack input and consumed1,draw null or actual result and original outcome;both success/failure deduplicated;replay returns original receipt,no second charm/cost/draw;uncertain save retries original outcome

random_flow_binding.scope: eligible_owners三类强化全部尝试（含optional_charm_selector=null）同一随机绑定，不只选符才采用；非完整强化事件schema，不单独开放服务。
random_flow_binding.identity: random_flow.receipt_id=原强化提交事件ID，原成功/失败收据内只一份random_flow；不另生成抽奖事件或消费另一settlement编号。
random_flow_binding.probability: authority从原recipe与真实已选符定义算base/effective bp，冻结原报价；base10000选符非法，effective10000（含由符补满）实际roll=null/success=true/random_flow.streams=[]，角色及world计数均不变。其他合法有效概率1..9999仅一次uniform_integer(0,9999)。
random_flow_binding.draw: 非必成仅一条character流，owner_id=原命令实际character_id，algorithm/seed/before精确原角色random_state；draws恰一项，purpose=ordinary_armor_enhance.roll、ordinary_weapon_enhance.roll或hero_weapon_enhance.roll按原service类型精确选择。low=0/high=9999/result=原收据draw，success=(result<effective_bp)。拒绝块数量可>1，但只一业务样本，after精确重算。world流及其他角色流禁止。
random_flow_binding.cost_and_result: 原费用/材料与可选符成功失败均按原owner消费，失败仍是已提交抽样而非aborted。原实例保同ID，成功+1/失败保持，无多次试到成功；完整石/符堆流、银两流、实例成长和业务修订/角色RNG after同笔。
random_flow_binding.precommit_failure: 原资格/修订/库存/支付/最终负重失败在候选中放弃，不提交counter或费用；抽样耗尽亦整笔拒绝，不用默认成功或替代种子。正式提交后保存不确定按原事件核决定，不再次抽/扣费。
random_flow_binding.validation: 流重算之外逐条核当前原recipe/from级别、源实例、符真定义/源堆、base/effective概率及成败产物关系，结构合法draw不能授权客户端改概率。未知purpose/多draw/确定档有流/非确定档空流/错流拥有者均拒绝。
random_flow_binding.boundary: 三类强化采用随机绑定设计；完整强化命令/冻结计划/提交事件schema和实际服务/故障测试仍待，当前不声称运行接入完成。
